data.name: Fathia
data.gender_notes: Fathia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fathia is derived from the Arabic word 'fath', meaning 'to open' or 'to conquer'. It symbolizes abundance and wealth in Islamic tradition. The name Fathia carries the meaning “Abundance, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fathia usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fathia is associated with the concept of 'fath' in the Quran, which refers to the opening of hearts and minds to Allah's guidance.
data.etymology: Fathia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fathia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
